Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:11:1.hebrew: תרתי לריעותא - טמא על חזקתו, והרי חסר לפניך:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:11:1.english: Two [factors] of impairment - The ritually impure [person] stands on his presumptive status, and behold, [the ritual bath] is deficient before you.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:11:2.hebrew: הכא - גבי קידושי האב, חדא לריעותא הוא דאיכא: הרי בוגרת לפנינו. אבל אם באת לומר "העמד אשה על חזקתה" — יומא דמשלם שית, לאו חזקת בגרות ולאו חזקת נערות אית בה, שהיום היא עשויה להשתנות:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:11:2.english: Here - With regard to the father’s betrothal, there is only one factor of impairment: behold, she is a grown woman before us. But if you were to say, “Maintain the woman in her presumptive status [as a young woman]” — on the day that completes six [months], she has neither a presumption of being a grown woman nor a presumption of being a young woman, for on this day she is poised to change.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:12:1.hebrew: היה בודק את החבית - תמיד, שלא תחמיץ, והניח אותה החבית להיות מפריש עליה והולך — כלומר: להיות סומך עליה בהפרשת תרומותיו. כשבא לשתות מאה לוגין טבל במקום אחר, אומר: "הרי שני לוגין בחבית פלונית תרומה על מאה לוגין הללו", וכן עושה תדיר. ואח"כ נמצאת חומץ, ואין ידוע מאימתי החמיצה; וכל תרומה שסמך עליה משהחמיצה — לא תיקן, דקסבר: יין וחומץ שני מינין הן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:12:1.english: One would inspect the barrel - Constantly, so that it would not sour, and he designated that barrel to continually separate [teruma] on its basis — that is, to rely upon it for the separation of his terumot: When he came to drink one hundred log of untithed produce [tevel] elsewhere, he would say: “Behold, two log in such-and-such barrel are teruma for these one hundred log,” and he would do so regularly. And afterward it was found to be vinegar, and it is not known from when it soured; and any teruma that he relied upon [from it] once it had soured did not rectify [the produce], for he maintains: Wine and vinegar are two [distinct] species.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:12:2.hebrew: כל ג' ימים ודאי - גרסינן, ולא גרסינן הראשונים. אמוראי פליגי בה בב"ב (דף צו.): איכא למ"ד, כל ג' ימים הראשונים שאחר הבדיקה, שבדקה ומצאה יין, הרי היא בחזקת יין ודאי, וכל טבלים שתלה תרומתן בה באותן ג' ימים מתוקנים הן. מכאן ואילך — ספק, והויא תרומה ליאסר לזרים, ויחזור ויתרום, דשמא כבר החמיצה ולא היתה תרומה. ואיכא למ"ד, כל ג' ימים שלפני בדיקה זו האחרונה, שמצאה חומץ, הרי היא בחזקת ודאי חומץ; ואם עשאה באותן ג' ימים תרומה על מקום אחר — אינה תרומה, ומותרת לזרים אם יתקננה מטבלה, דלא הוי חומץ גמור בפחות מג' ימים, וזו שנמצאת חומץ — בידוע שלשה ימים יש שנתקלקלה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:12:2.english: All three days [it is] definite - We read [this], and we do not read "the first [three days]." Amoraim disagree about it in Bava Batra (96a): There is one who says [that] all the first three days following the inspection, in which he inspected it and found it [to be] wine, it has the presumptive status of definite wine, and all untithed produce whose teruma he made dependent upon it during those three days are rectified. From then onward [it is] uncertain, and it is [treated as] teruma so as to be forbidden to non-priests, and he must go back and separate teruma [again], lest it had already turned to vinegar and was not [valid] teruma. And there is one who says [that] all three days preceding this final inspection, in which he found it [to be] vinegar, it has the presumptive status of definite vinegar; and if he made it teruma for [produce in] another place during those three days, it is not teruma, and it is permitted to non-priests if he rectifies it from its untithed state, for it does not become complete vinegar in less than three days, and since this [barrel] was found to be vinegar, it is known that three days have passed since it spoiled.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:12:3.hebrew: מכאן ואילך - מג' ולמפרע ספק, והוי תרומה ליאסר לזרים, ויחזור ויתרום:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:12:3.english: From then onward - From three [days prior] retroactively, [it is] an uncertainty; and it is [treated as] teruma to be forbidden to non-priests, and he must go back and separate teruma [again].

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:13:1.hebrew: מ"ש - גבי מקוה, דמחזקינן ליה בחסר משעה ראשונה שהנחנוהו בחזקת שלם — דקתני: כל טהרות שנעשו על גביו, אפילו ברשות הרבים, טמאות. אלמא לאו ספק הוא, דאי ספק הוא — הוה ליה למימר: ברה"ר טהורות. והאי מקוה, על כרחיך בתחילתו השלימוהו בארבעים סאה, וקא מחזקינן ליה מהאי שעתא בחזקת חסר ודאי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:13:1.english: What is different - Regarding the ritual bath, where we presume it to be deficient from the first time that we left it in the presumption of being complete — as it teaches: "All purities that were prepared using it, even in a public domain, are impure." Evidently it is not an uncertainty, for if it were an uncertainty, it should have said [that] in a public domain [they are] pure. And this ritual bath, perforce, they initially completed with forty se'ah, and [yet] we presume it from that time to be definitely deficient.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:13:2.hebrew: ומאי שנא - גבי חבית, דקתני מכאן ולהלן ספק, ולא אמרינן: משעתא דסליק ידיו מלבודקו החמיץ:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:13:2.english: And what is different - Regarding the barrel, where it teaches [that] from here and onward [it is] uncertain, and we do not say [that] from the time he withdrew his hands from checking it, it soured?

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:14:1.english: And Rabbi Ḥanina - [This is the] reading:

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:15:1.hebrew: ברה"י תולין - כל ספק טומאה לר"ש, ברה"י תולין, כדמפרש טעמא בשמעתא קמייתא דנדה (דף ג.), דלא דמי לספק סוטה, דהתם יש רגלים לדבר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:15:1.english: In the private domain, [they] suspend - Every [case of] uncertain ritual impurity according to Rabbi Shimon, in the private domain [they] suspend, as the reason is explained in the first sugya of Niddah (daf 3a), that it is not similar to the uncertainty of a sotah, as there, there is a basis for the matter.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:16:1.hebrew: טבל למפרע - זה שניתקן על ידי חבית זו, דאמרינן: מדהשתא החמיץ, מעיקרא נמי חומץ; וה"נ נימא: מדהשתא בוגרת, בצפרא נמי בוגרת:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:16:1.english: Untithed produce retroactively - [This refers to the produce] that was rectified by means of this barrel, for we say: Since it has soured now, initially it was also vinegar; and so too, let us say: Since she is a mature woman [bogeret] now, in the morning she was also a mature woman.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:19:1.english: Shall we say [it is parallel to a dispute between] Tannaim - This [dispute] of Rav and Shmuel.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:1:1.english: Both of them give a bill of divorce - If she comes to marry another [man].

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:3:1.hebrew: משום דגברא קים ליה ביוחסין - וכשמצא מיוחסת, קידשה לו וביטל את השליח. אבל איתתא, דלא קים לה ביוחסין, אימא: אע"ג דקידשה עצמה, לא ביטלה את השליח ולא סמכה על קידושיה, דסברא: דילמא שליח משכח מיוחס מזה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:3:1.english: Because a man is knowledgeable in lineage - And when he found [a woman of] distinguished lineage, he betrothed her to himself and revoked [the authority of] the agent. But a woman, who is not knowledgeable in lineage — say [that] even though she betrothed herself, she did not revoke the agent and did not rely on her [own] betrothal, as she reasoned: “Perhaps the agent will find [someone of] more distinguished lineage than this one.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:4:1.hebrew: לא איכפת ליה - בבתו, אם תנשא למיוחס כל דהו, ולא בטליה לשליחות דשליח, ואפילו מקדשה לגרוע. והא דקדים קדשה — סבר: דילמא לא משכח; אבל אי משכח, לא בטליה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:4:1.english: He does not care - Regarding his daughter, whether she marries someone of any lineage whatsoever, and [therefore] he did not cancel the agency of the agent, even if [the agent] betroths her to an inferior [match]. And that which he went ahead and betrothed her [himself] — he reasoned: Perhaps [the agent] will not find [anyone]; but if he finds [someone], he did not cancel [the agency].

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:5:1.english: And she betrothed herself in the city - On that same day.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:5:2.hebrew: והרי היא בוגרת - בדקנוה לדעת אם יצאה מרשות האב להיות קדושיה קידושין, ומצאנוה בוגרת בו ביום:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:5:2.english: And behold, she is a grown woman - We examined her to determine whether she had left her father's authority so that her betrothal would be a [valid] betrothal, and we found her to be a grown woman on that very day.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:5:3.hebrew: הרי בוגרת לפנינו - וקדושיה קידושין, ולא של אביה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:5:3.english: Behold, [she is] a grown woman before us - And her betrothal is a [valid] betrothal, and not [that] of her father.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:5:4.hebrew: חיישינן לקידושי שניהם - שמא כשקידשה האב נערה היתה, וקדמו קידושיו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:5:4.english: We are concerned with regard to the betrothal of both of them - Perhaps when the father betrothed her she was a young woman, and his betrothal preceded [hers].

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:6:1.hebrew: אי נימא בתוך ששה - חדשים שבין נערות לבגרות, דאמרינן: "אין בין נערות לבגרות אלא ששה חדשים בלבד". כשהביאה סימני נערות אינה שוהה להיות בוגרת אלא ששה חדשים, ופעמים שהיא ממהרת לבגור וסימניה ניכרים בדדיה, כדתנן במס' נדה (דף מז.): "פגה, בוחל, וצמל":
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:6:1.english: If we say within six - Months that are between maidenhood and adulthood, as we say: “There is between maidenhood and adulthood only six months.” Once she brings forth the signs of maidenhood, she does not delay in becoming an adult woman more than six months; and sometimes she matures quickly, and her signs are recognizable in her breasts, as we learned in the Mishnah in Tractate Niddah (47a): “An unripe fig, a ripening fig, and a fully ripe fig.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:6:2.hebrew: בהא אמר רב הרי בוגרת לפנינו - הא כל אותן ששה חדשים בחזקת נערה היא, עד שנכיר בסימני בגרותה. וכי בדקנוה בפניא ואישתכחא בוגרת, מי יימר דצפרא נמי בוגרת היא? ודילמא השתא הוא דבגרה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:6:2.english: In this [case] did Rav say: She is a grown woman before us? - Behold, throughout all those six months she has the presumptive status of a young woman, until we identify the signs of her majority. And even if we examined her in the evening and she was found [to be] a grown woman, who is to say that in the morning she was also a grown woman? And perhaps it is [only] now that she reached her majority!

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:6:3.hebrew: אלא לאחר ששה - חדשים, והא ודאי משמלאו לה ששה חדשים בגרה לה. "וכי תימא בציר הוא דליכא, הא טפי איכא, הא אלא בלבד קאמר" — לא גרס. דמהיכא תיסק אדעתין למימר הכי? מי קאמר אין בין נערות לבגרות פחות מששה חדשים?:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:6:3.english: Rather, after six - [Six] months. But surely once six months have been completed for her, she has become a grown woman! “And if you should say: It is less [than six months] that cannot be, but more there can be — behold, he said ‘only’ [and] ‘alone’!” — is not the correct reading. For from where would it enter our minds to say this? Did he say: “The difference between the status of a young woman and the status of a grown woman is no less than six months”?

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:7:1.hebrew: דקדיש ביומא דמשלים שית - אביה בבוקר, והיא בערב, והיום הזה היא בחזקת שתבגר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:7:1.english: Where he betrothed on the day that completes six [months] - Her father [betrothed her] in the morning, and she [betrothed herself] in the evening; and on this day she is presumed to become a grown woman.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:7:2.english: Since she is now a grown woman, she was also a grown woman in the morning - For the entire day she is presumed to produce [signs].

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:8:1.english: Upon it - [That is,] with vessels that one immersed in it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:8:2.english: Whether it is in the private domain - Where an uncertainty regarding ritual impurity is [ruled] impure.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:8:3.hebrew: בין שנעשו ברה"ר - שספק טומאה טהור בו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:8:3.english: Whether they were performed in the public domain - Where a doubtful [case of] impurity is [ordinarily] pure.

Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:8:4.hebrew: טמאות - דלאו ספק הוא, אלא ודאי. אלמא אמרינן: כשעת מציאתן מחזקינן ליה מעיקרא. הכא נמי נימא: מדהשתא בוגרת — בצפרא נמי בוגרת, שכל היום היא בחזקת שתביא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 79a:8:4.english: Are impure - For it is not [a matter of] doubt, but certainty. Evidently, we say: In accordance with the time of their discovery, we establish it [to have been] from the beginning. Here too, let us say: Since she is now a grown woman, in the morning also [she was] a grown woman, for all day she is in the presumption that she will produce [signs of majority].

Tosafot on Kiddushin 79a:10:1.hebrew: [אדרבה העמד מקוה על חזקתו ואימר לא חסר - לשון אדרבה קשה, דהל"ל לחומרא. ומיהו, הכא איכא לפרושי: היכי שרפינן עלה קדשים? אבל גבי יין לקמן, אין שייך ליישב כך. ת"י]:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 79a:10:1.english: ["On the contrary, maintain the ritual bath in its presumptive status, and say it was not deficient" — The wording "on the contrary" is difficult, for it should have said [that we rule] stringently. However, here it can be explained: How do we burn consecrated items on account of it? But regarding the wine below, it is not applicable to resolve [the difficulty] in this manner. — Tosafot Yeshanim]

Tosafot on Kiddushin 79a:12:1.hebrew: כל ג' ימים ודאי - ל"ג הראשונים, דהא פליגי בה אמוראי (בב"ב דף צו.): דאיכא למ"ד ג' ימים הראשונים ודאי יין, מכאן ואילך ספק; ואיכא למ"ד ג' ימים האחרונים ודאי חומץ, ומקודם ספק; ואיכא למ"ד דג' ימים הראשונים ודאי יין, וג' ימים האחרונים ודאי חומץ, ובינתיים ספק:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 79a:12:1.english: "All three days it is definitely" - We do not read "the first," for Amora'im disagree about this in Bava Batra (96a): as there is one authority who says that the first three days are definitely wine, and from then on it is uncertain; and there is one authority who says that the last three days are definitely vinegar, and beforehand it is uncertain; and there is one authority who says that the first three days are definitely wine, and the last three days are definitely vinegar, and in between it is uncertain.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 79a:5:1.hebrew: קידשה אביה בדרך כו' וקידשה עצמה וכו' - וא"ת: אמאי איפליגו רב ושמואל בכה"ג? נפלגו בקידשה אביה גרידא, כמה דפירש דפליגי בקידשה אביה ואחר כך קידשה היא עצמה! וי"ל: דודאי לא פליגי בקידשה אביה לחוד, דבההיא מודה שמואל דאינה מקודשת, דאמרינן: העמד אשה אחזקת פנויה כמו שהיתה קודם שקידשה, והרי היא בוגרת לפנינו, ואין קידושי האב קידושין. אבל עתה שקדשה אף היא עצמה, ליכא חזקה דפנויה, דממה נפשך אשת איש היא — או משום קידושי אביה או משום קידושי דידה — וליכא האי סברא; ומשום הכי פליג שמואל:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 79a:5:1.english: "Her father betrothed her on the way, etc., and she betrothed herself, etc." - And if you say: Why did Rav and Shmuel disagree in such a case? Let them disagree in [a case where] her father alone betrothed her, just as [it was] explained that they disagree where her father betrothed her and afterward she betrothed herself! And one can say: They certainly do not disagree in [a case where] her father betrothed her alone, for in that [case] Shmuel concedes that she is not betrothed, for we say: Maintain a woman in her presumption of being unmarried, as she was before he betrothed her; and she is a grown woman before us, so the father's betrothal is not a [valid] betrothal. But now that she too betrothed herself, there is no presumption of being unmarried, for whichever way you look at it she is a married woman — either because of her father's betrothal or because of her own betrothal — and this reasoning does not apply; and for this reason Shmuel disagrees.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 79a:6:1.hebrew: [אילימא בתוך ששה וכו' - מתוך פי' רש"י משמע דבדקוה בתוך ו' ומצאוה בוגרת, ומש"ה פריך: בהא לימא וכו'? ואין נראה, דלעולם לא תמהר לבגור תוך ו'; אלא מיירי דבאה לפנינו אחר ששה, ול"ג: "השתא הוא דבגרה". ת"י]:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 79a:6:1.english: ["If we say during the six" etc. - From Rashi's commentary it implies that they examined her within the six [months] and found her [to be] a grown woman (bogeret), and that is why [the Gemara] challenges: In that [case] would [Rav] say, etc.? But it does not seem [correct], for [a girl] never matures early within six [months]; rather, [the Gemara] is dealing with [a case where] she came before us after six [months], and we do not read: "It is only now that she matured." — Tosafot Yeshanim]:

Tosafot on Kiddushin 79a:8:1.hebrew: ושמואל מ"ש ממקוה - ואם תאמר: לרב נמי תקשי, דע"כ לא קאמר רב דמצפרא נמי בוגרת הויא אלא משום דליכא חזקה דנערות, כדפי' בקונטרס; אבל אי הויא חזקה דנערות, מודה רב דאוקמא אחזקתה, והכי נמי גבי מקוה איכא חזקה דשלם! וי"ל: דלרב נמי קשה, ונקט שמואל משום דפריך ליה בהדיא טפי:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 79a:8:1.english: "And [according to] Shmuel, in what way is [this case] different from a ritual bath?" - And if you say: [This] should be difficult for Rav as well, for perforce Rav said that she was already a grown woman in the morning as well only because there is no presumptive status of young womanhood, as explained in the Kuntres [Rashi]; but if there were a presumptive status of young womanhood, Rav would concede that we maintain her in her presumptive status, and so too regarding a ritual bath, there is a presumptive status of [it being] complete! And it can be answered: It is difficult for Rav as well, and [the Gemara] formulated [the challenge against] Shmuel because it refutes him more directly.
